title: Step 2 - Imputing Missing Data in Python: SimpleImputer and Numerical Columns

cues.en: Instructor: Okay, then almost last step.
cues.zh: 好，快到最後一步了。

cues.en: Now remember this is just an object.
cues.zh: 別忘了，目前它只是一個物件。

cues.en: We haven't connected anything yet to our matrix of features.
cues.zh: 還沒有和特徵矩陣建立任何連結。

cues.en: So the next step is indeed to apply this imputer object on the matrix of features.
cues.zh: 所以下一步，是把 imputer 物件套用到特徵矩陣。

cues.en: So how are we going to do that?
cues.zh: 要怎麼做呢？

cues.en: Well, remember that a class contains an assemble of instructions but also some operations and actions which you can apply to other objects or variables.
cues.zh: 類別不只包含一組指令，也包含能套用到其他物件或變數上的操作。

cues.en: And these are called methods.
cues.zh: 這些就叫做方法。

cues.en: You know, they're like functions and one of them is exactly the fit method.
cues.zh: 它們很像函式，其中之一就是 fit 方法。

cues.en: The fit method will exactly connect this imputer to the matrix of features.
cues.zh: fit 方法會讓 imputer 與特徵矩陣建立連結。

cues.en: In other words, what this fit method will do is it will look at the missing values in, you know, the salary column and also it will compute the average of the salaries.
cues.zh: 換句話說，它會查看薪資欄位中的遺漏值，並計算平均薪資。

cues.en: All right, so that's simply what it will do.
cues.zh: 單純就是這些工作。

cues.en: And then that will not be enough to do the replacement we want.
cues.zh: 但這還不足以完成我們要的替換。

cues.en: To do the replacement we'll have to call another method called transform and which will this time apply the transformation meaning it will replace the missing salary here
cues.zh: 要實際替換，還必須呼叫 transform 方法，它會執行轉換，把缺少的薪資

cues.en: by the average of the salaries.
cues.zh: 替換成平均薪資。

cues.en: Okay, so let's do this.
cues.zh: 現在來做。

cues.en: Let's first call the fit method.
cues.zh: 先呼叫 fit 方法。

cues.en: In order to do this, well of course we have to call first our object imputer.
cues.zh: 當然，要先取出 imputer 物件。

cues.en: And then from the subject, you know, adding a dot, we will call the fit method, which has some parenthesis because it's like a function inside a class.
cues.zh: 在物件後面加句點，再呼叫 fit，後面加括號，因為它就像類別裡的函式。

cues.en: And what does this function expect as argument?
cues.zh: 那麼，這個函式需要什麼引數？

cues.en: Well, it simply expects all the columns of X with numerical values but only the ones with numerical values not the ones with text or strings or categories.
cues.zh: 它需要 X 中的數值欄位，而且只能是數值欄位，不能是文字、字串或類別欄位。

cues.en: And so, well, how do we get this column?
cues.zh: 那該如何取得這些欄位？

cues.en: Well, first let's get the matrix of features X 'cause that's where we want to replace the missing data.
cues.zh: 先取出特徵矩陣 X，因為我們要填補的遺漏值就在這裡。

cues.en: And from this matrix of features X well first we're going to look at all the rows.
cues.zh: 在 X 裡，首先選取所有列。

cues.en: You know this fit method will read the whole column that we specify inside this fit method.
cues.zh: fit 會讀取我們指定欄位的全部資料。

cues.en: But then for the columns here, you know we could specify all the columns where to look for some missing data.
cues.zh: 至於欄位，本來可以指定所有欄位來檢查遺漏值。

cues.en: However, this first column has danger.
cues.zh: 但第一欄有個問題。

cues.en: You know, it is column with strings and therefore this might cause a warning or an error when looking for some missing data here.
cues.zh: 它包含字串，所以檢查這一欄的遺漏值時，可能產生警告或錯誤。

cues.en: Therefore, we are only going to specify these columns with only real numbers, age and salary.
cues.zh: 因此，只選取包含實數的 Age 與 Salary 欄位。

cues.en: And therefore here we're gonna enter the range from one to be careful not two, because remember the upper bound of a range in Python is excluded.
cues.zh: 這裡的範圍從 1 開始，但注意，不能到 2，因為 Python 範圍不包含上界。

cues.en: So if we exclude two, this will exclude the salary.
cues.zh: 如果上界設為 2，就會排除薪資欄。

cues.en: Therefore we have to go up to three.
cues.zh: 所以必須設到 3。

cues.en: Okay, up to three.
cues.zh: 沒錯，到 3。

cues.en: So that while this fit method, we'll look for all the missing values in the age column and the salary column.
cues.zh: 這樣 fit 就會查看 Age 與 Salary 欄位的所有遺漏值。

cues.en: So here we're specifying specific columns which are the age column and the salary column.
cues.zh: 這裡明確指定的，就是年齡與薪資欄。

cues.en: And that's because we know that there is a missing salary.
cues.zh: 因為我們知道有一筆薪資遺漏。

cues.en: And by the way, there is also a missing age.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，也有一筆年齡遺漏。

cues.en: However, I recommend on a general rule to select all the numerical columns because in your career you will actually work with huge data sets and you won't be able to see where the missing values are.
cues.zh: 不過，通常我建議選取全部數值欄位，因為工作中可能遇到龐大資料集，無法一眼看出遺漏值在哪裡。

cues.en: So just include all the numerical columns to make sure to replace any missing data.
cues.zh: 所以把全部數值欄位納入，確保所有遺漏資料都能填補。

cues.en: Remember to exclude these ones, the string columns, okay?
cues.zh: 記得排除字串欄位。

cues.en: So that's just something important to consider.
cues.zh: 這是要注意的重要事項。

cues.en: And then here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: This will connect our imputer to our matrix of features.
cues.zh: 這會把 imputer 與特徵矩陣連結起來。

cues.en: And now final step we have to call the transform method once again from our imputer object.
cues.zh: 最後，再從 imputer 物件呼叫 transform 方法。

cues.en: And so this transform method will exactly do that replacement of the missing salary here by the mean of the salaries.
cues.zh: transform 會把缺少的薪資，真正替換成平均薪資。

cues.en: And same for the missing age.
cues.zh: 缺少的年齡也一樣。

cues.en: It'll be replaced by the mean of all the ages in the age column.
cues.zh: 它會用 Age 欄位的平均年齡來填補。

cues.en: And so according to you, what do we have to input here?
cues.zh: 你認為這裡該傳入什麼？

cues.en: Well, there is no trap here.
cues.zh: 沒有陷阱。

cues.en: We of course have to input the columns of X where we want to replace missing data.
cues.zh: 當然是 X 中要填補遺漏資料的那些欄位。

cues.en: And so these are the age column and the salary column.
cues.zh: 也就是 Age 與 Salary。

cues.en: And therefore we simply have to input exactly the same as what was input in the fit method.
cues.zh: 因此，只要傳入和 fit 完全相同的內容。

cues.en: So we're just gonna take this, copy this and paste that inside the transform method.
cues.zh: 把這一段複製，貼到 transform 裡。

cues.en: However, be careful, this transform method actually returns the new updated version of the matrix features X with the two replacements
cues.zh: 但請注意，transform 會傳回更新後的特徵資料，已完成

cues.en: of the missing salary and the missing age.
cues.zh: 遺漏薪資與遺漏年齡的替換。

cues.en: And therefore, what we want to do now and that's the last we have to do is to indeed update our matrix of features X.
cues.zh: 因此，最後要用這個結果，更新特徵矩陣 X。

cues.en: And to do this well since this exactly returns these two columns here with that replacement done, well, what we want to do to update X
cues.zh: 由於它傳回的，正好是完成替換後的這兩欄，要更新 X，

cues.en: is actually to take this, you know, take this second and third column of X matrix features and change it by what will be returned
cues.zh: 就必須取出 X 的第二、第三欄，並將它們改成

cues.en: by this transform function of the imputer object so that the second and third columns of X will be replaced with that average age and average salary.
cues.zh: imputer.transform 傳回的值，這樣兩個欄位的遺漏值就會替換成平均年齡與平均薪資。

cues.en: And therefore the whole matrix of features X will be exactly the same but with these new average age and average salary.
cues.zh: 整個特徵矩陣 X 其他內容不變，只更新這些平均年齡與平均薪資。

cues.en: Okay, we're gonna check that right away now.
cues.zh: 現在馬上檢查。

cues.en: To do so, we're gonna create a new code cell where we are going to print the new matrix of features X.
cues.zh: 建立新的程式儲存格，輸出更新後的 X。

cues.en: And let's see if indeed that missing value that we can clearly see here as once again, NAN is replaced in this new version of X.
cues.zh: 看看原本明顯標示為 NaN 的遺漏值，是否已在新的 X 中被替換。

cues.en: So let's not forget to run these two cells here.
cues.zh: 別忘了，先執行這兩個儲存格。

cues.en: This first cell to indeed replace the missing data and now this cell to print the new matrix X.
cues.zh: 第一格實際填補遺漏資料，再用這一格輸出新的 X。

cues.en: And there you go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: As we can clearly see that missing salary in the previous matrix of features X was indeed replaced by the average salaries of this column.
cues.zh: 可以清楚看到，原本特徵矩陣中缺少的薪資，已經替換成這一欄的平均薪資。

cues.en: Okay, check that if you want, but there you go.
cues.zh: 如果需要，可以自行核算。

cues.en: Now you have another tool in your data processing toolkit.
cues.zh: 現在，資料前處理工具箱又多了一項工具。

cues.en: So congratulations.
cues.zh: 恭喜。

cues.en: And now we're gonna proceed to a new tool which is to end code categorical data.
cues.zh: 接下來學習新的工具：編碼類別資料。
